about: Example demo cases built from the made-up TEST- records in quick_tests (load 1_single_add.json and 2_batch_add.json first). Same shape as the full demo_cases.json, which is not published.

groups.title: 1. Exact repeats -> CLEAR (no AI)
groups.what: Same customer, list hit and listing as a whitelisted record.

groups.title: 2. No listing details -> REVIEW (no AI)
groups.what: Nothing to compare, so a human reviews.

groups.title: 3. Clearly not the listed person -> CLEAR (no AI)
groups.what: Customer scores below 0.80 against the listing.

groups.title: 6. Whitelisted case, address written differently -> AI should CLEAR
groups.what: Not an exact repeat, so the AI checks whether the earlier reason still holds.
